title: Cam Nou Museum Immersive Tour
text: Valeria helped us tour the Camp Nou museum; she was very knowledgeable and answered all our questions about FC Barcelona. She made the experience more enjoyable.
author: Jessica_M

title: Lovely experience with great guide!
text: Ivan is a very good guide, thank you for the attention, the specifications and having patience! Very friendly and good treating the public. I recommend it

title: Phenomenal guide!
text:
A phenomenal guide! A lot of walking, but well worth it 
The immersive experience at the stadium was amazing
author: alan_r

title: Our tour guide though...
text:
Our tour guide though very young demontrated tremendous knowledge, passion about the Camp Nou while guiding us through the accessible areas during the tour with lots of support, unusual maturity, friendliness thus  making Barca the center of life. She really made us feel welcome with unforgettable memories.

It was a triple 'A' experience, all thanks to our female guide.
author: OLALEKAN_O

title: Great time!
text: Even though the stadium is still under construction, we enjoyed the experience and learning the history of FC Barcelona, with our guide, Enrique. He was very knowledgeable and  gave us time to look through the museum, answer our questions and also gave us history of the different players. The story of the club is very interesting and we hope to come back when Camp Nou and the Plaça is completed. I also really like that the team is partnered with UNICEF and humanitarian efforts
author: Jill_R

title: Amazing Experience
text: Sarah was very friendly and knowledgeable!  I was a solo traveler, so she helped capture the moment by taking my pictures.
author: Sherry_S

title: Camp Nour. a must experience especially if you ae a soccer fan
text: The entire  tour was breathtaking. Our tour guide was very knowledgable, The Barcelona facility was inspiring.
author: garyr679

title: A MUST if you love soccer.
text:
Our tour guide Daniel made this experience extremely enjoyable. It was our first trip to Spain so we specifically selected the guided tour and we are so glad we did. Daniel was prompt picking us up at our hotel. He did not drive us to Camp Nou but instead we took the metro.  We are so glad we did because we got to experience taking the metro. We ended up using it throughout our remaining vacation in Barcelona because it is so easy, fast and cheap.
Once at Camp Nou, Daniel took us throughout the museum and stadium showing us every step of the way about the stadium and the team’s history, player
author: Neyma C

title: Great tour for a soccer loving family
text: Ha I was a great tour guide—so informative and flexed for our interests. Was very personable and great with touring kids as well. Highly recommend this tour for a family.
author: Karen_R

title: FC Barcelona experience
text: Excellent guide (Aron) who was very informative and interesting to listen to. The stadium is very impressive and we really enjoyed the museum.
